scope: Accepted five-run takeover; frozen model/cohort/scorer retained
search_threads_meaning: imported benchmark default; not zero worker threads
sparsity: enable only; never force or alter model weights

match.pair_sizing: Run 3, from pilot runtime and available window before production results
match.warmup: one unscored 2000ms search per engine before match clocks

known_failure_fallback: Only exact nvinfer_plugin_10.dll open failure at initial probe may defer the standalone profiling/peaks branch; independent lc0 jobs continue. Retain incomplete deliverables.
unknown_failure: Preserve attempt, mark BLOCKED and stop; no silent retry or skipped new error
measurement_interference: Save work, close nonessential apps, pause other work. Record process/resource observations before/after jobs and lightweight telemetry during jobs. Preserve and explicitly invalidate externally contaminated attempts; never filter based on speed or outcome.
temperature_clocks: Fixed AC/power/cooling conditions, common conditioning, counterbalanced headlines. Log natural temperatures/clocks; no fixed-clock or thermal-equilibrium claim.
measurement_acceptance: Exit status, complete positive outputs and source identities are necessary. Run 3 separately audits environmental validity, uncertainty, precision evidence and comparability.
